items.question: What is the fine range under the UAE compulsory education law for a parent or legal guardian who fails to enrol a child in school?
items.gold: AED 2,000 to AED 50,000, possibly with imprisonment.
items.fact: Non-enrolment fine ranges from AED 2,000 to AED 50,000.

items.question: Under the UAE compulsory education rules, how many working days after a written warning must a violation continue before the Ministry of Education reports it to the Public Prosecution?
items.gold: More than 10 working days after the written warning.
items.fact: Violations continuing over 10 working days after warning go to prosecution.
